summary: Seema Badar is an owner-confirmed member of the pro-Palestine Muslim community, which this guide treats as affirmative evidence of general alignment with Palestinian justice. CAIR Action issued a full general-election endorsement and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally, both concrete directional signals under their stated methodologies. BAMC Action supported her candidacy, commenting she would bring "balance to the curriculum" in the Dublin Unified School District, a remark that addresses education rather than Palestine policy directly.
